source_scope: Single-component evaluations. The 1360 passages were generated after the original dual-Qwen and ATLAS releases, with labels recorded by their publisher. The adaptive rule was selected after earlier evaluation on these same texts. The full V30 SVC4 supervised pool matches 233 of 270 smaller-cohort texts and all 270 prompt fingerprints. The handwriting ensemble member separately matches 205 texts.
rules: V4/V6 placement: fix the pre-ATLAS GLM gate, temperature, likelihood weight and post-GLM logits for a projection. Add only the 10% top-four delta relative to the pre-GLM base, then rerun corrected style. Actual min 50 bypasses GLM for both small batches. Proxy selects floor(0.15*N) without the minimum, comparing original 54 and paired 76 classifiers. Legacy uncorrected label routing is outside this V4 comparison. No GLM supplied for 1360.
bootstrap: 3000 paired bootstrap draws among unique prompts within each observed true class; macro recall class-balanced; ordinary accuracy keeps observed class proportions. Both intervals concern the delta.
